primaryChecks.text: He went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in the country of Ashdod, and among the Philistines.
primaryChecks.previousContext: He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the vision of God; and as long as he sought the LORD, God made him prosper.
primaryChecks.nextContext: God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who lived in Gur Baal, and the Meunim.
